title: PostgreSQL crash due to disk full on data partition
symptoms: Application returned 500 errors on all database queries
syslog: 'No space left on device' on /dev/sdb1
root_cause: WAL (Write-Ahead Log) files accumulated without archiving due to misconfigured archive_command in postgresql.conf
resolution: 1. Identified WAL files consuming 180GB of 200GB partition. 2. Safely removed old WAL files that were already archived. 3. Restarted PostgreSQL. 4. Fixed archive_command to use proper pg_wal archive path. 5. Set up automated WAL retention policy. 6. Added disk monitoring alert at 80%.
follow_up: Configure automated WAL archival, set up partition monitoring, plan disk expansion to 500GB
